features.name: offer_action_word_sum
features.description: Sum of word-frequency columns that represent offer or action cues in the standard Spambase column order: remove, order, free, credit, 000, and money.
features.expected_model_benefit: Consolidates several sparse promotional/action terms into one thresholdable score, letting a tree split on combined presence rather than many separate branches.
features.formula: word_freq_6 + word_freq_8 + word_freq_15 + word_freq_19 + word_freq_22 + word_freq_23

features.name: contact_route_word_sum
features.description: Sum of routing and contact wording columns in the standard Spambase column order: address, mail, receive, addresses, email, and direct.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates related contact-route cues into a compact measure that supports simple tree thresholds for recipient-contact language.
features.formula: word_freq_1 + word_freq_9 + word_freq_10 + word_freq_14 + word_freq_17 + word_freq_39

features.name: personal_addressing_word_sum
features.description: Combined frequency of direct personal-addressing terms in the standard Spambase column order: you and your.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures direct-addressing intensity as a single split variable, including nonlinear interactions with punctuation and capitalization cues.

features.name: work_thread_context_word_sum
features.description: Broad sum of technical, workplace, academic, and correspondence-thread word columns in the standard Spambase column order.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures context-rich workplace or technical language in one feature, helping trees form branches for rows dominated by thread-style wording.
features.formula: word_freq_24 + word_freq_25 + word_freq_26 + word_freq_27 + word_freq_28 + word_freq_29 + word_freq_30 + word_freq_31 + word_freq_32 + word_freq_33 + word_freq_34 + word_freq_35 + word_freq_36 + word_freq_37 + word_freq_38 + word_freq_40 + word_freq_41 + word_freq_42 + word_freq_43 + word_freq_44 + word_freq_45 + word_freq_46 + word_freq_47

features.name: offer_context_balance_ratio
features.description: Ratio of promotional, contact-route, and personal-addressing wording to workplace, technical, academic, and thread-context wording.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a nonlinear contrast between solicitation-style wording and context-heavy wording, giving trees useful high-versus-low split points.
features.formula: (word_freq_6 + word_freq_8 + word_freq_15 + word_freq_19 + word_freq_22 + word_freq_23 + word_freq_1 + word_freq_9 + word_freq_10 + word_freq_14 + word_freq_17 + word_freq_39 + word_freq_18 + word_freq_20) / (1.0 + word_freq_24 + word_freq_25 + word_freq_26 + word_freq_27 + word_freq_28 + word_freq_29 + word_freq_30 + word_freq_31 + word_freq_32 + word_freq_33 + word_freq_34 + word_freq_35 + word_freq_36 + word_freq_37 + word_freq_38 + word_freq_40 + word_freq_41 + word_freq_42 + word_freq_43 + word_freq_44 + word_freq_45 + word_freq_46 + word_freq_47)

features.name: punctuation_emphasis_log
features.description: Log-scaled combined frequency of exclamation, currency, and hash characters.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses heavy-tailed emphasis punctuation into a stable numeric span with direct tree split points.

features.name: currency_or_bang_flag
features.description: Binary indicator for conspicuous currency or exclamation usage using unsupervised training-fold scale thresholds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a clean boolean split for rows with visibly elevated money or exclamation styling.

features.name: structure_to_emphasis_ratio
features.description: Ratio of structured punctuation frequency, using semicolon, parenthesis, and bracket characters, to emphasis punctuation frequency.
features.expected_model_benefit: Contrasts formatting-oriented punctuation with emphasis-oriented punctuation, which trees can split on to identify different writing styles.

features.name: capital_extent_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket for capitalization extent using total and longest capital-run length thresholds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns highly skewed capitalization-run measures into interpretable buckets aligned with natural tree split behavior.

features.name: capital_bang_interaction
features.description: Product of log-scaled longest capital run and log-scaled exclamation frequency.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates high values only when long capital bursts and exclamation usage occur together, giving trees a direct interaction feature.

features.name: commercial_intent_judgment
features.description: Ordinal 0-4 semantic score assigned from this row's word-frequency, character-frequency, and capital-run pattern for commercial offer or solicitation tone; 0 means none and 4 means very strong.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a coarse semantic view that can group diverse commercial cues into one split variable.

features.name: work_thread_context_judgment
features.description: Ordinal 0-4 semantic score assigned from this row's pattern for workplace, technical, academic, or ongoing correspondence context; 0 means none and 4 means very strong.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a coarse context view for rows resembling workplace or academic threads even when no single context column is large.
